title: Prove the uniform query floor for the shared dirty BIT pair
body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #4068: jointly mixing the independent inputs of helpers413/444 cannot reduce the fixed pair's stipulated query tariff below `2 Phi_m(2)`, for `0 <= b <= 1`, in the uniform unary-query model. The two original rank-two calls attain this bound even when scalar mixing and finite restored dirty or clean workspace are free.

The package supplies the written proof, an independent source binding, finite algebra controls, reviewed implementation, and explicit packing proposals with their missing costs. [Proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de9deae2b787143923c0a504fbcc3871d01cff0b/research/bit-joint-dirty-pair/PROOF.md) · [Scope and reproduction](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/de9deae2b787143923c0a504fbcc3871d01cff0b/research/bit-joint-dirty-pair/README.md).

## Scope and limits

Fixed finite rational address maps, the same word for all sufficiently large odd address primes, one VALUE stream per query, address-independent scalar mixing, and the complete endpoint before the same injective suffix. The proof includes clean ancillary columns; it does not use a fixed-field representation as a faithful group algebra.

Changed downstream compensation, modulus-dependent words, and newly priced tagged/packed primitives remain open. Query pricing is stipulated; no native supplier, formal-kernel proof, changed selected record or new kappa is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] Registered Python3.12 replay, normal and optimized:660 source columns, local retiming/inverse,32768 finite Sylvester controls and fixed-field representation controls.
- [x] All17 committed package files match the Git-free export; read-only normal/optimized replay passes with TMPDIR unset and unchanged bytes.
- [x] Source-byte corruption and a Boolean-to-integer receipt mutation are rejected for the expected reasons.
- [x] Clean merge-tree check against canonical `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`; current task card unchanged at priority revision7.

Hosted CI is separate from these local checks.

## Sources and credit

Pins PR4068 at `5a34918402ae2c0c683d8820ad832970e77f6382`, retaining Ali Romman's, Sagar Thakrar's and the credited controller/hosting lineage. Jose Manuel's PR2108 and earlier group-algebra/cut bounds are antecedents, not claimed new here. Full attribution and overlap limits are in SOURCE-NOTES.md.

Ross Richardson, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI proof/source reviews. Apache-2.0; no independent human certification.
